scripts.test:deadlines: node build.mjs && node deadlines.mjs && STALL_PHASE=body node deadlines.mjs
scripts.test:admission: node build.mjs && node build.mjs workflows && cargo build --locked -p ghinvite-github --features test-stub --example stub && node admission.mjs
scripts.test:installation: timeout --kill-after=35s 1200s sh -ec 'node build.mjs workflows && cargo build --locked -p ghinvite-github --features test-stub --example stub && INSTALLATION_ONLY=1 node admission.mjs'
